risk_note: RV2 (db/invariants). First batch of ledger invariant SQL for BR-FUND-19 1, 2, 3, 4 and 7 (db/invariants/ledger/01_user-balances, 02_voucher-balanced, 03_credit-unique, 04_beneficiary-net, 07_negative-balance-drops; ledger-plan D10 A, one file per invariant; 5, 6 and 8 follow with B2-04 / B2-05). Each file is one read-only SELECT with the same output shape (invariant, checked_rows, scope account | global | none, app_id, account_id, detail); no differences -> exactly one 'none' row; checked_rows 0 fails in tests (D18 A). Only 1 is per accounting date, read from couli.check_date set by the runner; no now() / CURRENT_DATE. daily_balances is in entry sign (decision 20). 1 reports a missing daily_balances row as an account-level difference for every user account sub-account that has appeared up to the check date (code review rounds 1 and 2). 4 and 7 check all history. Integer fen additions only. The orchestrator committed the round-1 files after the implementation subagent ended without its result file (decision 21), after a full verify on the test machine.
